summary.text: Mitchell Setzer is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 89 since 1999 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Setzer earned a B.A. from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro, and his professional experience includes serving as vice president of Smith Setzer & Sons, Inc.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Setzer as chair of the Insurance Committee, senior chair of the House Finance Committee and vice chair of the Ethics Committee, and as a member of the Energy and Public Utilities, Health, Local Government and UNC BOG Nominations committees.
